name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.184: The statistics now read as a table instead of one run-on sentence. Every counter
    gets its own row with the label on the left and the number on the right, so the numbers line up
    and can be compared at a glance. Each row names the direction it belongs to, and the wording says
    what happened rather than naming the code: uploads and downloads that were fetched and then
    thrown away, the type (movie/series) adjusted, the searches that only matched once the year tag
    was dropped, and the subtitles the run fitted to their audio track — that last one is a new
    counter, so the table shows how much of the correction work actually landed.
